Type: compact three-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes; bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: engineered wood with woodgrain laminate, small metal bar handles
Colors: dark warm walnut brown, silver
Shape: simple low box, three equal flat drawers, small centered handles, plinth base, compact and plain
Feel: practical, tidy, understated
Goes with: light walls, beige floors, white curtains; simple modern bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand - Solimo Tucana Engineered Wood Chest of Drawers (Walnut Durance Finish)
product.description: Premium-quality engineered wood chest of drawers which has undergone more than 20 safety and quality tests Material: European Standard Particle Board Smooth and curvilinear edges for protection against scrapes and cuts Earthy Walnut durance finish that gives it a warm look and makes cleaning an easy task Durable drawers that have been tested over 5,000 cycles Tested for resistance against humidity, stains and hot water Free from harmful carcinogens like lead, formaldehyde and pentachlorophenol (PCP) Comes with a 3-year warranty on manufacturing defects
